verdict.rationale: Railway docs mention an MCP server and 'Agent Skills' for AI-powered workflows, implying users can connect AI agents to operate Railway via natural language, but there is no first-party documentation of a native NL command interface, no detail on what commands are supported, and no independent/hands-on evidence that this actually works. missing for 10: detailed docs on the MCP server's command surface, first-party or independent demo of natural-language operation, evidence of reliability/hands-on testing.
